h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katihar

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Katihar

items.pText: Katihar is a railway junction town in north-east Bihar, in the low country between the Ganga and the rivers that come down from Nepal. Floods are part of life in this region, and school grounds and colony parks can stay under water for days. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it by road.

Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts come through standing water well, but a flood leaves behind silt, debris and loosened ground. The equipment should be checked before children use it again, however sound it looks. Our after-sales team can guide your staff through that check. If something has been damaged, send us photos and we will advise on repair or replacement parts. When planning a new play area here, also raise its base above the usual flood level where the site allows.

richText.heading: Checking a playground after floodwater recedes

items: Keep children out until the ground is dry and the equipment has been inspected.
Clear silt and debris from the flooring, decks and slide beds, and wash every surface with clean water.
Check each foundation for erosion, and push firmly on every post to test for movement.
Inspect springs, bearings and swing hangers, which suffer most from silt.

items.q: Is playground equipment safe to use after a flood?
items.a: Only after it has been cleaned and checked. Floodwater leaves silt in moving parts and can loosen foundations, so inspect every piece before reopening the play area.

items.q: Does floodwater damage galvanised and roto-moulded equipment?
items.a: These materials do not rust or rot in water, but silt wears bearings and springs, and soft ground can tilt posts. A full check after the water drains catches these problems early.

items.q: Do you supply Katihar and north-east Bihar?
items.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai to Katihar and nearby districts by road, and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Let us know if your site floods, and we will plan the base with that in mind.
